Title: Admins may see stale or incomplete data in the Microsoft 365 Copilot Usage and Copilot chat reports

User impact: Admins may see stale or incomplete data in the Copilot Usage and Copilot chat reports.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Microsoft Copilot and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Admins may see stale or incomplete data in the Microsoft 365 Copilot usage and Copilot chat reports

User impact: Admins may see stale or incomplete data in the Copilot usage and Copilot chat reports in the Microsoft 365 admin center

Current status: We've identified that an upstream data dependency is currently unavailable which is necessary for the data pipeline to process Copilot Usage and Copilot Chat report data, and is resulting in impact. We're investigating the underlying reason behind this upstream data delay issue so that we can determine whether any mitigative actions are necessary to help the affected pipelines recover.

Scope of impact: Admins located in North America, Asia Pacific, and Europe attempting to view up-to-date or complete Copilot Usage and Copilot chat report data within Microsoft 365 admin center may be impacted. This section may be updated as our investigation continues.

Root cause: An upstream data dependency is currently unavailable, which is necessary for the data pipeline to process Copilot Usage and Copilot Chat report data, and is resulting in impact.

Next update by: Saturday, September 19, 2026, at 7:00 PM UTC

Title: Admins may see stale or incomplete data in the Microsoft 365 Copilot usage and Copilot chat reports

User impact: Admins may have seen stale data in the Copilot usage and Copilot chat reports in the Microsoft 365 admin center

Final status: We've implemented a fix to retore the upstream data dependency to expected functionality, and confirmed through monitoring service health telemetry that the impact has been remediated.

Scope of impact: Admins located in North America, Asia Pacific, and Europe attempting to view up-to-date or complete Copilot Usage and Copilot chat report data within Microsoft 365 admin center may have been impacted.

Start time: Saturday, September 19, 2026, at 12:00 AM UTC

End time: Saturday, September 19, 2026, at 9:00 AM UTC

Root cause: An upstream data dependency was currently unavailable, which was necessary for the data pipeline to process Copilot Usage and Copilot Chat report data, and was resulting in impact.

Next steps: 
- We're reviewing the upstream data dependency to determine why it was failing to process requests as expected, so that we can prevent similar issues from occurring in the future.

This is the final update for the event.
